source.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
source.text: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved. The article GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy appeared first on The Decoder .
